CustomField.description: Lower bound for a plausible feed. Fewer rows than this and FSD 5.9.6 step 2 halts rather than treating the missing tenants as resolved. There is no hardcoded fallback in Apex: if this is unset the run halts.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Halt if the feed returns fewer rows than this.
CustomField.label: Minimum Row Count
